description: Write a committed markdown document enumerating the concrete MANUAL steps needed to ensure the database is up to date and ready for the current version of the page, specific to THIS repo's supabase/ setup. Covers applying the migrations (especially 0017/0018/0019), regenerating TypeScript types via `supabase gen types`, env/config prerequisites from .env.example, and an explicit note that these could not be executed/verified in the sandbox. ASK 3 of the user instruction (literally 'escreva aqui o que precisa ser feito manualmente').
steps: Create docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md (create the docs/ directory). Base every step on the ACTUAL repo: supabase/config.toml (project_id=kiro-athen, major_version 17, enable_confirmations=false locally), supabase/README.md (migration map + apply options), supabase/migrations/ (0001..0019), .env.example (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY), README.md. Do NOT invent generic steps.

Document applying the migrations in filename order via the two real paths this repo supports: (A) Supabase CLI — `supabase db reset` (fresh local, applies all in order) or `supabase db push` (against a linked project), and (B) SQL editor — paste each file in order. Call out that order matters (later migrations reference earlier objects).

Specifically describe the NEWER migrations that gate behavior/shape and MUST be applied to make the current page work: 0017_enroll_own_course.sql (lets a creator self-enroll in their own course via the enrollments_insert_own RLS so finalize/enroll on own course works), 0018_no_xp_for_already_correct.sql (anti-regrind: finalize_attempt no longer re-awards XP for an already-correct question), and 0019_course_edit_gating.sql (adds courses.published_at + backfill + set_course_published_at trigger + the split draft/published INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RLS policies on modules/lessons/questions that power the new editing UI). Explain what each enables for the UI.

Document regenerating the TypeScript types AFTER applying 0019, because it adds the courses.published_at column: `supabase gen types typescript --project-id <ref> > src/types/database.ts` (or the local `--local` variant). Note that src/types/database.ts is user-generated and intentionally never hand-edited, and that the app's TS build stays green against the generated shape via src/types/supabase-compat.ts; the client code does not query published_at directly, but the regeneration keeps the generated types faithful to the live schema.

Document the env/config prerequisites: copy .env.example to .env.local and set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (Project Settings -> API). Mention these must also be set in the deploy environment (Vercel) per README. Note that src/lib/supabase.ts throws at startup if they are missing.

Add an explicit limitation note: these steps could NOT be executed or verified in the sandbox because there is no live Supabase instance; RLS, triggers, and SQL functions can only be exercised against a real project and must be run there by a human.

Link the new doc from README.md (e.g. a short 'Banco de dados / setup manual' pointer near the existing Setup section) so it is discoverable. Keep the doc self-contained and accurate; written in Portuguese to match the repo's docs, with exact commands.
Run prettier (format:check includes markdown) so the doc passes formatting.
acceptance_criteria: docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md exists and is self-contained, accurate to this repo (references real files: supabase/config.toml, supabase/migrations/0001..0019, .env.example), and written in Portuguese.
It documents applying migrations in order via `supabase db reset`/`supabase db push` and the SQL-editor fallback.
It specifically explains 0017, 0018, and 0019 and what each enables for the current page (self-enroll own course, anti-regrind XP, course-edit gating + published_at).
It documents `supabase gen types` into src/types/database.ts after 0019 and that the file is generated (never hand-edited).
It documents the required env vars from .env.example and that supabase.ts fails loudly when they are missing.
It explicitly states the steps were not executable/verifiable in the sandbox (no live Supabase).
README.md links to the new doc.
verification: Read docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md and confirm it matches the actual supabase/ migrations list and .env.example keys.
findings: Created docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md (pt-BR, self-contained) and linked it from README.md near the Setup section. Doc grounded in actual repo files: lists all real migrations 0001..0019 (confirmed via ls), documents both apply paths (supabase db reset / db push + SQL editor fallback) with order-matters note, explains 0017 (enrollments_insert_own self-enroll own course), 0018 (anti-regrind finalize_attempt awards 0 XP for already-correct questions), and 0019 (courses.published_at + idempotent backfill + set_course_published_at trigger + split INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RLS on modules/lessons/questions = draft fully editable, published only accepts new modules while prior content is immutable). Documents regenerating types via `supabase gen types typescript --project-id <ref>` / `--local` into src/types/database.ts after 0019, that the file must not be hand-edited, and that the TS build stays green via NormalizeDatabase in src/types/supabase-compat.ts (client never queries published_at directly). Documents env prereqs from .env.example (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY), copy to .env.local + Vercel, and that src/lib/supabase.ts throws at startup when missing. Includes explicit sandbox-limitation note (no live Supabase; RLS/triggers/SQL only verifiable by a human). Verified: `npx prettier --check docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md README.md` clean; `grep -n DATABASE_SETUP README.md` confirms the link; no em dashes in the files I touched. NOTE: src/types/database.ts header actually says 'Hand-written to match the SQL in supabase/migrations/'; the doc phrases the regen step as the recommended way to keep it faithful and states it should not be hand-edited, consistent with the briefing intent while remaining accurate. Pre-existing unrelated format:check findings elsewhere (.agents review .md, possibly supabase/README.md) were left untouched. Docs-only change: no build/test run needed.
